prose.text: **No smoke entry, no live leg, no mutation run.** The product binary is unchanged, so there is no `smoke` entry. The test-plan declares no boot-smoke path list. The harness `boot` changes only the stamping verify's parent-death signal, and its CLI arm (`for_cli`, untied) is unchanged. No live `claude` start and no mutation run (`inputs#I1` item 6).

**Bounds and sockets.** Every wait this chunk adds goes through `WITHIN` (12 s), below the mutants kill (15 s), the 20 s lint and cargo-mutants' 20 s floor (`tests/contract_lints.rs` `test_deadlines_sit_below_the_nextest_kill_line`, entry 11). No test socket is added; a booted session's sockets stay in the product's per-user directory as today.

**Why the run needs CI.** The acceptance needs CI (`inputs#I1` item 4), so the operator pass carries pre-push, hygiene, push and the CI read. `deny.toml` is no Rust source, and nothing here is OS-conditional (Linux only, one `ubuntu-latest` leg).

**Filters.** Every filter is checked to select at least one test. Entries 8 and 9 select today's cases (harness_tied: `killed_test_leaves_no_harness_session`; harness_lifecycle and viola-e2e's `cli`: their booted cases). Entry 10 selects the MCP binaries' `harness_session` boots.

**What would turn each predicate red:** - **Entry 3.** It reads red on any new advisory against the root graph: an `unmaintained`, `unsound` or vulnerability   id, or a yanked crate. - **Entry 4.** It reads red on the same against the fuzz graph. - **Entry 5.** It reads red when the ignore list gains or loses any id. So the ignore is no wider than this one id. - **RUSTSEC-2026-0543 itself.** cargo-deny's ignore entry is keyed on the id alone; this chunk writes its only fields,   `id` and `reason`. So the same id turns no reader red once a safe upgrade exists. A withdrawn advisory reads   `advisory-not-detected`, a warning (measured on cargo-deny 0.20.2: four such warnings, exit 0). The founder's re-read   at each epoch boundary is the control for a safe upgrade. That this cargo-deny ignores an id whatever its patched   versions is read from the config's field set and not measured; it is recorded as an owed reading below.

**Controls.** Each is implement's one-shot `gate.py control`, never an entry, fired with `--timeout 600` on the entry filtered to its own case. 600 s covers the control clone's cold build of the filtered binary: the last chunk read its firings at 4.4–47.56 s, `doc:2026-11-17-booted-wrapper-does-not-outlive-its-test/plan` §Test Commands. «Holds» means the named case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line; a `timeout` reading reads the control NOT held. - `vfy-term` — `crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/boot.rs`: the SIGTERM `stamp` passes to `tie_to_caller` replaced by   SIGKILL, today's signal. Case `killed_test_leaves_no_stamping_verify`, on entry 8. It holds when the case fails on its   dir read: a SIGKILLed verify leaves its run dirs. - `vfy-tie` — `crates/viola-e2e/src/harness/boot.rs`: `stamp`'s `tie_to_caller` call removed. Case   `killed_test_leaves_no_stamping_verify`, on entry 8. It holds when the case fails on its process read; `gone_within`'s   failure path kills the recorded survivors, so the firing leaves nothing running. - `e2e-census` — `crates/viola-e2e/tests/harness_lifecycle.rs`: `options()`'s `tied: true` reverted to `tied: false`.   Case `viola_e2e_census_finds_no_untied_boot`, on entry 8.
